raw_case_text: The patient was treated with 2HRZE/4HR regimen of Isoniazid (300 mg), Rifampicin (450 mg), Ethambutol (800 mg), and Pyrazinamide (1500 mg) on alternate days thrice a week for two months, followed by Rifampicin (450 mg) and Isoniazid (300 mg) on alternate days, thrice a week for the next four months. The patient showed marked improvement in symptoms and became asymptomatic within two months. The child is presently under followup to complete the prescribed regimen.

assessment_and_plan.assessment_and_confirmation: Antimicrobial regimen and outcome: Treated with an intermittent 2HRZE/4HR antitubercular regimen consisting of isoniazid (300 mg), rifampicin (450 mg), ethambutol (800 mg), and pyrazinamide (1500 mg) on alternate days thrice weekly for 2 months, followed by rifampicin (450 mg) and isoniazid (300 mg) on alternate days thrice weekly for the subsequent 4 months. The pediatric patient demonstrated marked symptomatic improvement and became completely asymptomatic within 2 months, remaining under active follow-up to complete the prescribed 6-month regimen.
